text: The thing is that this MH invitation is not that straightforward too. When I asked about it while getting my first A5 they told me this - wait at least another year, because most likely it will be refused. While going too often to your home country is also frowned upon hehehe. I didn't try yet myself, but I saw many reports that in some branches they simply refuse to accept the requests if the family is from the visa free country (like Romania) or if you want to invite a friend. That they say - if they will be deported then come 👍
